messages:
Alicia (Support): urgent escalation from support -> BeaconPay onboarding is hitting payment processor callback failures in prod, customers getting 500s during card tokenization. onboarding check-in scheduled for TOMORROW 14:00 UTC — renewal/GO-LIVE at risk.
Mike (CS Lead): copying in CS. thanks for flagging, Alicia. can you paste the error snippet and scope? is this isolated to one merchant account or global for BeaconPay?
Alicia (Support): appears to be all new onboarding flows for BeaconPay EU region. sample error from logs:
```
ERROR http 502 /v1/payments/callback request_id=abc123 org=beaconpay cluster=prod-eu-2 upstream_timeout
```
We see retries but client-side timeout hits at ~10s. earliest occurrence 2026-11-03T09:12Z, still happening.
Riley (Solutions Eng): likely upstream processor (procx) returning intermittent 504s. temporary mitigation: increase client retry window and add idempotency at our payment gateway to avoid double-charges. quick config patch we can push:
```
redwood.gateway.retry_policy = { attempts: 3, base_backoff_ms: 300, max_backoff_ms: 2000 }
redwood.gateway.timeout_ms = 20000
```
This is safe for onboarding flows. I'll prepare a canary config for prod-eu-2.
Devin (Account Mgr): customer-facing comms needed. proposing this plan:
- T+0: acknowledge (Alicia) -> "We see the issue, engineering investigating; we'll update in 2 hours"
- T+2h: technical update (Riley + Jordan) with mitigation status
- T+6h or EOD: follow-up and next steps; schedule show-and-tell before tomorrow check-in
Mike (CS Lead): that timeline works. include risk posture and proposed goodwill (one month credit or extended trial) if go-live is delayed. cc legal if we propose credits.
Jordan (SRE): I can scope the incident. running `kubectl logs` and tracing for procx upstream latency. initial signal looks like 2% of requests to procx are `502/504`. I'll attach traces in 30m. temporary rule: route BeaconPay onboarding through fallback procx-b if available.
Alicia (Support): customer is already spooked — they pinged me asking if we can pause the check-in. Devin, can you own the customer ack now? I'll provide them the `request_id` samples.
Devin (Account Mgr): on it. Draft ack: "Thanks Alicia — we're investigating. Engineering will update in ~2 hours. We understand this is urgent for your go-live and will prioritize." will send in 5.
Riley (Solutions Eng): I can push the retry/timeout patch to prod-eu-2 as a canary in 15m, then monitor error rate. if metrics improve, we do a full roll in 60m.
Mike (CS Lead): action items:
- Alicia: give Devin request samples + customer contact
- Devin: send ack + own comms thread
- Riley: push canary patch + monitor (report T+2h)
- Jordan: attach traces + propose fallback routing if canary fails
- Mike: prepare exec summary for AM leads and CRO if renewal impact > $50k
incident-bot: incident created -> INC-2026-1187: payment-callbacks-prod-eu-2
Alicia (Support): all set, request samples posted to shared drive. pinging @Riley for canary.
Riley (Solutions Eng): starting canary rollout now -> prod-eu-2/canary/redo-1842501111, will post metrics in #eng-runtime and update here.
Devin (Account Mgr): ack sent to BeaconPay contact (Emma). scheduled a touchpoint for tomorrow 14:00 but noted we may reschedule depending on fix. Emma replied: "Please prioritize — we need to go live this week." adding pressure.
Mike (CS Lead): thanks team. maintain tight comms. I'll prepare a short customer-facing status note for the check-in if this isn't resolved by 11:00 UTC tomorrow. also tagging Legal for any credit approvals.
Jordan (SRE): uploaded traces + initial root-cause hypothesis: intermittent procx timeouts due to a degraded node pool after a recent infra deploy. rollback tested in staging shows improvement.
Riley (Solutions Eng): canary shows errors drop from 2% -> 0.3% after patch and fallback to procx-b. recommending full roll in 45m unless Jordan sees something blocking.
Mike (CS Lead): final confirmation: if roll goes green, Devin will send technical update + plan for immediate go/no-go decision at tomorrow check-in. if not green, propose credits and reschedule check-in. good work, everyone. :thumbsup:
summary: Support escalated a payment callback failure for BeaconPay onboarding in prod-eu-2 that risks upcoming go-live and renewal. Team agreed mitigation (increase timeouts/retries, route to fallback processor), canary rollout underway, and a comms plan with timestamps and ownership assigned. incident ticket INC-2026-1187 created.
